tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind panels; the app shell content area.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks and wells sunk below the panel.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panel, modal, menu and topbar surface. Most text sits here.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Sidebar, table header row, modal footer: a step off panel.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Row and menu-item hover fill.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav item, active segment. Text on it is accent-fg.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel edges, row dividers, toolbar rules.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Popover and modal edges; dashed inherit cells. Decorative, not a control edge.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Edge of every input, select, button, segmented control, filter chip and checkbox. 3:1 on panel and panel-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on panel, panel-2, bg, hover and selected.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: nav items, labels, table body detail. On panel, panel-2, bg and muted-soft.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Metadata, column headers, timestamps, placeholders. 4.5:1 on panel, panel-2 and bg in both themes; never on a status soft fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, focus ring, selected tab underline, links in charts. One accent per screen region.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent-tinted fill behind accent-fg: staff badge, active toggle chip, bulk-selection bar.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Accent as text: links, active nav label, override cells. On panel, accent-soft and selected.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy / running / sent / active. As text on ok-soft or panel; as a dot or bar fill.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind ok text in badges and banners.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Degraded / lagging / retrying / stale / needs attention. As text on warn-soft or panel.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn text: stale banner, unsaved-change bar, secret reveal box.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Down / failed / paused / destructive. As text on err-soft or panel; danger button fill.

tokens.name: on-err
tokens.usage: Label on an err fill (danger button).

tokens.name: err-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind err text: module-unavailable icon well, error banner, no-access cell.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Pending, read-only notices, informational banners. As text on info-soft or panel.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind info text: read-only banner, pending badge.

tokens.name: muted-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral badge fill and skeleton base; behind text-2.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First series in charts and KPI sparklines.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series (right axis), storage sparklines.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals, the search palette and the tablet nav drawer.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: One sans at ops density. 13px is the base; nothing in the portal goes above 22px.

styles.name: ts-kpi-value
styles.usage: The number in a KpiTile. Tabular figures.

styles.name: ts-page-title
styles.usage: One per page, top left. Entity names in EntityDetail headers.

styles.name: ts-modal-title
styles.usage: Modal and confirmation titles. A question when the user must decide.

styles.name: ts-panel-title
styles.usage: Panel headers. Sentence case, no trailing punctuation.

styles.name: ts-body
styles.sample: Each lock is force-unlocked on its repository.
styles.usage: Everything not listed here: forms, menus, property lists, modal bodies.

styles.name: ts-table
styles.usage: Table cells, timeline entries, menu items.

styles.name: ts-meta
styles.sample: last push 6 min ago by diego.r
styles.usage: Secondary lines, panel meta, helper text, footers. In text-3 or text-2.

styles.name: ts-label
styles.usage: Column headers, badges, tags, KPI deltas.

styles.name: ts-section-label
styles.usage: Nav section titles, timeline day dividers, menu group headers. Uppercase via CSS, in text-3.

styles.name: ts-mono
styles.usage: Ids, hashes, paths, topics, cron, config keys, error strings.

styles.name: ts-tag
styles.usage: Tag chips: branch names, EntityRefs, scopes, providers.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs, uptime bars, attempt pips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Menu inner padding, icon-to-label in tight chips.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar items and badge rows; label-to-value in facts.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls; table toolbar and footer vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; tab padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel body padding, grid gap between panels, table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Modal padding; minimum side gutter; topbar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, kbd hints, checkbox cells, matrix cells, skeleton bars.

tokens.name: radius-item
tokens.usage: Nav items and menu items (inset inside a rounded container).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls, code blocks, impact lists.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, menus, popovers, the secret-reveal box.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and the search palette; 20px-tall status badges (a pill).

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Only on things that float: menus, popovers, modals, the palette, toasts. Panels never cast shadows.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar column on desktop; becomes a 248px drawer under 1080px.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Topbar and brand row.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects. Small variant 24px.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table body row. Header row 32px.
